title: Cut-off quadratic moments over n-planes, with a constant depending only on n
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, and for every P ∈ ℕ let Hⁿ = μHE[n] be the normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P). There is a single constant c > 0 depending only on n — the same c for every ambient dimension P, every subspace Q and every vector u — such that for every P ∈ ℕ, every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P with dim Q = n and every u ∈ ℝ^P, ∫_Q max(1 − |y|², 0)·⟨u, y⟩² dHⁿ(y) = c·|p_Q u|². Here ∫_Q means integration against Hⁿ⌞Q (Hⁿ on ℝ^P restricted to Q) and p_Q = Q.starProjection is the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto Q.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → ∀ u : Euclid P, ∫ y in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), max (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) 0 * inner ℝ u y ^ 2 ∂μHE[n] = c * ‖Q.starProjection u‖ ^ 2
